name: strudel-ai
description: Strudel live-coding REPL with an AI chat co-pilot (Claude, llama.cpp, OpenWebUI) — Docker or Netlify

scripts.check: for f in server.js prompt.js server/*.js netlify/functions/*.mjs netlify/edge-functions/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs public/*.js public/lib/*.js public/features/*.js public/templates/*.js public/ui/*.js public/plugins/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done
